subject: Sponsor intro and demo — evening preferred, exec coverage question
messages:
From: Lin Chen <lin.chen@novaforge.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Dec 2026 20:05:00 -0500
Subject: Intro + ask: executive slot availability for demo

Hi Kimberly / Ben,

Thanks again for the quick intro call this morning. We wrapped up internally and the execs here (VP of Product — Sanjay, and CIO — coming from APAC) want to attend the product walkthrough. Because of our CTO's travel, the team prefers an evening PT slot so the CTO and Sanjay can both be present (roughly 5:30–7:00 PM PT).

Are you able to run a 45–60 minute deep-dive during that window next week? Main asks from our side: 1) high-level performance profile for 8k token sequences, 2) routing/fallback behavior during high throughput bursts, and 3) an ops/observability tour focused on time-to-incident.

I can share our org chart and a short list of use-cases — attaching. If evening is difficult, a narrow morning window (9:00–10:00 PT) would also work but is less preferred.

Appreciate any exec-available options.

Best,
Lin

Attachments: org_chart_novaforge.pdf
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Lin Chen <lin.chen@novaforge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2026 08:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro + ask: executive slot availability for demo

Hi Lin — thanks for the clear asks and for sending the org chart.

Evening PT slots are doable for us next week but we need to confirm sponsorship coverage on the Red­wood side (VP/CIO-level presence). Ben, can you confirm whether you or Marissa can join the 5:30–6:30 PM PT block on Wednesday (12/15) or Thursday (12/16)? If neither of you are available, we can run the technical walk-through with a senior product lead and schedule an abbreviated exec intro (20 minutes) at the top of the call — but we want to avoid a second meeting if possible.

I've attached a one-page demo agenda and a suggested mutual action plan (stub). If you confirm Wednesday/Thursday evening we will lock a recording consent request in the calendar for your CIO.

Kimberly Park
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0199

Attachments: demo_agenda_v1.pdf, mutual_action_plan.xlsx
From: Lin Chen <lin.chen@novaforge.com>

Cc: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@novaforge.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2026 11:47:00 +0000

On Tue, Dec 14, 2026 at 08:14 AM Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Lin — thanks for the clear asks and for sending the org chart.
> 
> Evening PT slots are doable for us next week but we need to confirm sponsorship coverage on the Redwood side (VP/CIO-level presence). Ben, can you confirm whether you or Marissa can join the 5:30–6:30 PM PT block on Wednesday (12/15) or Thursday (12/16)?

Thanks — Wednesday 12/15 evening is our first preference. Recording is fine (our CIO will join from Singapore and prefers a recording for internal review). If you need to split the session, we can do a short 20-minute exec intro + 40-minute technical run; otherwise full 60 minutes is fine.

Sanjay will be on the line and I will forward a few internal context bullets before the meeting. We do have a brief travel constraint on the CTO (overnight transit), which is why evening helps.

Regards,
Lin

Attachments: none
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Hi Lin — appreciate the context and the preference for Wednesday.

I can cover the exec intro piece at 5:30 PM PT on 12/15 and Marissa will lead the product deep-dive if I'm tied up during the later portion. Either way, we will ensure a VP-level handoff at the start and the technical run-through immediately after.

Kimberly / Marissa: please add a calendar invite for 12/15 17:30–18:30 PT and include the recording consent language. Lin — I attached the mutual action plan with a few proposed pre-demo items (slide deck, small eval prompt set) so we can align on success criteria before the meeting.
